summary: Architectural plan for a stripped-down, clutter-free, laser-focused ImageFit. Eliminates all secondary feature clutter (no watermarks, no logo overlays, no EXIF scrubbers, no auto-enhance filters) and keeps strictly the 4 essential controls: Dimensions, Fit Mode, Background Padding, and Format. Designed for dead-simple, effortless image fitting that outperforms cluttered corporate tools.
